function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data.  
If you want to know the current time in New York, you can:

1. **Check your phone/computer** – most devices automatically show the correct local time when set to “New York” or “Eastern Time”.
2. **Use a world‑clock website** – sites like timeanddate.com or worldtimebuddy.com let you look up the present time for any city.
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc., will tell you “It’s 3:45 PM in New York right now.”

If you’re coding, you can get the current UTC time and then apply the Eastern Time offset (UTC‑5 normally, UTC‑4 during daylight saving time) to estimate the local time.
